answer: One defence is Praised estate valuer commission with estate valuers attestation: a commission valuers renew after valuation audits, and the anchor of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a commission valuers renew after valuation audits is something they already have; the mesa falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The basalt grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
